§3§lPurpose and mechanism§r
The Mega Steam Turbine Array is a twin-row axial generator. Build one base ring group and §10-4§r additional groups, each adding §112§r blocks of depth. For k additional groups, the base generation multiplier is §14§r, power-group count is §1k+2§r and physical ring-group count is §1k+1§r; the extra base power does not add another efficiency or steam-savings bonus. The structure subchannel is spelled lenght: values §11-5§r select §10-4§r additional groups.

§3§lPreparation and operation§r
Use uniform steel, titanium or tungstensteel material casings, pipes, gearboxes and frames. Standard machine casings set voltage; glass cannot be below that tier, and hatches can replace standard machine-casing positions. Ordinary and superheated steam work at every casing tier; dense-family and supercritical steam require §1LuV (tier 6)§r or higher. Provide a steam inlet, a suitable fluid/cooling outlet and a dynamo; ME and native fluid-based crafting buffers can supply steam, and ordinary, multi-amp and laser dynamos are supported. Plan cooled-fluid recovery and the electrical destination. §cRequested EU output above combined dynamo capacity causes an explosion.§r Recalculate after changing rings, steam, power settings, singularities or chips. This is a manual reading check.
